title: Pink Button-Up & Rimless Glasses at Night
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair and rimless glasses stands on a city street at night. She wears a fitted pink button-up shirt with a cinched waist, open at the neckline over a black bralette, and a black shoulder bag strap across her body. Dark low-rise denim jeans complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm streetlight and a glowing storefront behind her. Palette of blush pink, deep navy, and warm amber. Sleek and candid, in the style of a night street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The fitted pink shirt and rimless glasses are the defining details.
- Keep the warm storefront glow for a nighttime city atmosphere.
